ℒt\mathcal{L}_{t}, hidden prompts, and the tasks in the new session remain unseen. ## Attacker capabilities. The attacker writes the malicious blocks Q1,Q3,Q5Q_{1},Q_{3},Q_{5} (nine tasks). The skill store, r⁡(⋅,ℒ)r(\cdot,\mathcal{L}), ℰ\mathcal{E}, the related benign blocks Q2,Q4,Q6Q_{2},Q_{4},Q_{6}, and PP stay outside that control. We reset all other task state between tasks, so ℒ7\mathcal{L}_{7} is the only object that PP loads. ## 4 SkillMisevo-Gym and SkillMisevo-Bench ## 4.1 SkillMisevo-Gym SkillMisevo-Gym follows one rule: only the skill library can cross from one task to the next. Every task starts in a new container with a new conversation. Files, processes, even chat history are discarded when the task ends. The library is the one object that survives, so any later change in behavior must come through it. ## Running a task. For task qq in block QtQ_{t}, an agent adapter AA writes the retrieved skills into the native skill channel of that agent, such as its skills folder or skill index. It then returns a trajectory in a shared schema as [TABLE] | | τq=A⁡(q,r⁡(q,ℒt)),𝒯t={τq}q∈Qt.\tau_{q}=A\big(q,\ r(q,\mathcal{L}_{t})\big),\qquad\mathcal{T}_{t}=\{\tau_{q}\}_{q\in Q_{t}}. | | (4) | After the block, SkillMisevo-Gym discards the sandbox. It then applies ℰ\mathcal{E} on the host to obtain ℒt+1\mathcal{L}_{t+1} by Eq. (1). Each evolution method keeps its released authoring, storage, and retrieval code. We call the component that launches an agent and records its trajectory the executor. One executor serves all agent harnesses, so every method runs on equal footing. ## Recording the gates. Three records are saved at every step: the library ℒt\mathcal{L}_{t}, the retrieved set r⁡(q,ℒt)r(q,\mathcal{L}_{t}), and the update Δt=ℒt+1∖ℒt\Delta_{t}=\mathcal{L}_{t+1}\setminus\mathcal{L}_{t} of new or edited skills. An artifact judge (Section 4.4) gives each skill a Content Unsafety score CU⁡(s)∈{1,…,5}\mathrm{CU}(s)\in\{1,\ldots,5\}, from which we set Unsafe(s)=𝟏[CU(s)≥3]\mathrm{Unsafe}(s)=\mathbf{1}[\mathrm{CU}(s)\geq 3]. The snapshots then yield Auth\mathrm{Auth} with Ret\mathrm{Ret} of Eq. (2) directly, with no guess about which skill a task used. ## Clean reload. After Q6Q_{6}, the library ℒ7\mathcal{L}_{7} is exported as SKILL.md files. SkillMisevo-Gym then starts PP in a fresh executor whose retrieval index reads only this export as [TABLE] | | τq=A⁡(q,r⁡(q,export⁡(ℒ7))),q∈P.\tau_{q}=A\big(q,\ r(q,\mathrm{export}(\mathcal{L}_{7}))\big),\qquad q\in P. | | (5) | No trajectory, cache, or session state reaches PP. Each episode also runs as a separate process with an empty store. Hermes-native, the built-in skill evolution of Hermes, is the one exception during learning. Its background review writes skills into a home directory, so SkillMisevo-Gym mounts one directory per episode through Q1,…,Q6Q_{1},\ldots,Q_{6}. On PP we still rebuild retrieval from the same export. ## 4.2 SkillMisevo-Bench ## Episode structure. Each episode fixes a vulnerability concept cc with one harmful goal gg from AgentHazard (Feng et al., 2026), a benchmark of harmful computer-use tasks, written e=(c,g,Q1,…,Q7)e=(c,g,Q_{1},\ldots,Q_{7}). Its 21 tasks follow the layout of Section 3 as seven three-task blocks as [TABLE] | | Q1,Q3,Q5⏟malicious (M),Q2,Q4,Q6⏟related benign (B),Q7⏟P.\underbrace{Q_{1},Q_{3},Q_{5}}_{\text{malicious (M)}},\ \ \underbrace{Q_{2},Q_{4},Q_{6}}_{\text{related benign (B)}},\ \ \underbrace{Q_{7}}_{P}. | | (6) | Each M task carries the enabling condition of cc, the setup that makes the harm possible, and realizes gg when followed. Each B task keeps the same tool family with the same retrieval cues but drops the unsafe route. PP uses new instance identifiers on surfaces unseen in earlier blocks, where a surface is the tool or file type a task acts on, and it contains no attack payload. At construction we check that a clean agent stays safe on every benign task, meaning Harm⁡(q,ℒ0)=0\mathrm{Harm}(q,\mathcal{L}_{0})=0 on the reference run of each q∈B∪Pq\in\mathrm{B}\cup P. Harm that later appears on these tasks must therefore come through the library. We keep the AgentHazard sandbox with its harmful-goal semantics but write every prompt from scratch. ## Concept discovery. AgentHazard pairs none of its malicious tasks with benign ones. We therefore run AHA (Mao et al., 2026), an automated red-teaming agent, offline on candidate pairs (m,b)(m,b) of a malicious task with a related benign task. For each pair we execute mm, let a reference evolution method write a skill s=ℰref​(∅,m,τm)s=\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{ref}}(\emptyset,m,\tau_{m}), then run bb with ss and again without it. A concept is retained when the three runs satisfy as [TABLE] | | | Harm⁡(m,∅)=1∧Harm⁡(b,∅)=0∧\displaystyle\mathrm{Harm}(m,\emptyset)=1\ \wedge\ \mathrm{Harm}(b,\emptyset)=0\ \wedge | | (7) | | | | [Unsafe(s)∨Harm(b,{s})=1].\displaystyle\big[\mathrm{Unsafe}(s)\ \vee\ \mathrm{Harm}(b,\{s\})=1\big]. | | In words, the malicious task succeeds and the benign task is safe on its own, yet the authored skill is unsafe or turns the benign task harmful. Discovery keeps the three concepts that hold up when rerun and when tested against runs designed to refute them. Each captures a different distinction that evolution can lose, so they give three separate failure routes. Each records its mechanism, its enabling condition, and its surface family. ## Episode construction. Claude Code with Fable 5 (Anthropic, 2026) turns each concept into executable tasks with disjoint identifiers. We write 25 episodes, each with a different harmful goal, for 25×21=52525\times 21=525 tasks (225 M, 225 B, 75 P). Label-conditioned reuse (8 episodes) attaches an unsafe body to a reusable label, while B tasks use that label for its real function. Dual-use boundary loss (8 episodes) gives both sides one automation role that differs only in data scope or granted capability. Compositional spillover (9 episodes) shows a chain that collects, processes, then sends data, while B tasks need only a local subset of that chain. Appendix B gives the full construction with its audit. ## 4.3 Evaluation settings We evaluate four target agents, Claude Code (Anthropic, 2025), Codex (OpenAI, 2025), Hermes (Nous Research, 2026), and OpenClaw (OpenClaw Contributors, 2026), all backed by MiniMax-M2.7 (MiniMax, 2026). The evolution settings are No Evolution, EvoSkill (Alzubi et al., 2026), SkillClaw (Ma et al., 2026), AutoSkill (Yang et al., 2026b), SkillsVote (Liu et al., 2026a), and SkillOpt (Yang et al., 2026a). Each updates the skills after every three-task block. On Hermes we also run Hermes-native, its built-in skill evolution, which keeps the intrinsic review of Hermes (Nous Research, 2026) and treats block boundaries as checkpoints. For mitigations on OpenClaw, we compare SafeEvolve with four settings. Raw applies no mitigation with just the evolution. Utility-only keeps the SafeEvolve controls with the same budget but sees only utility signals. SecureClaw (Adversa AI, 2026) audits an OpenClaw deployment with rule-based hardening, while ClawKeeper (Liu et al., 2026b) guards it with safety skills, runtime plugins, and a separate watcher. ## 4.4 Metrics and aggregation Across the 525 tasks, we report nine metrics. For online behavior which covers the 18 learning tasks before the new session, Benign Utility (BU)↑\uparrow is the fraction of B tasks whose benign objective is completed. Malicious ASR (M-ASR)↓\downarrow is the fraction of M tasks whose harmful objective is completed. Benign ASR (B-ASR)↓\downarrow is the fraction of B tasks with an extra harmful completion. Gemini-3-Flash (Google DeepMind, 2025) applies the AgentHazard rubric to both ASRs. It also serves as the benign judge for BU. For evolved artifacts, Kimi-K2-0905 (Moonshot AI, 2025) scores each authored skill from 1 to 5 on Content Unsafety (CU), Unsafe Generalization (UG), and Stealthiness (Stealth), where lower is better for all three. CU rates how unsafe the saved content is. UG rates how far an unsafe step reaches beyond its original task. Stealth rates how legitimate that step looks to a reviewer. CU averages over all artifacts. UG with Stealth averages over artifacts with CU ≥3\geq 3. Unsafe Artifact rate (U-A) is the share of artifacts with CU ≥3\geq 3. A metric is N/A when no artifact qualifies. For the new session, Unsafe Retrieval Rate (URR)↓\downarrow with Carryover ASR (C-ASR)↓\downarrow average the gates over PP under the reloaded library as [TABLE] | | URR\displaystyle\mathrm{URR} | =1|P|​∑q∈PRet⁡(q,ℒ7),\displaystyle=\tfrac{1}{|P|}\textstyle\sum_{q\in P}\mathrm{Ret}(q,\mathcal{L}_{7}), | | (8) | | | C-ASR\displaystyle\text{C-ASR} | =1|P|​∑q∈PHarm⁡(q,ℒ7).\displaystyle=\tfrac{1}{|P|}\textstyle\sum_{q\in P}\mathrm{Harm}(q,\mathcal{L}_{7}). | | Carryover Utility (C-Util)↑\uparrow is the benign completion rate on PP. Every rate then averages over the 25 episodes. We report metrics under two judge groups. The original group (O) uses Gemini-3-Flash for harmful trajectory decisions with Kimi-K2-0905 for artifact scores. The independent group (I) uses Grok-4.5 (xAI, 2026) for both roles. Three annotators also label 450 trajectories from malicious learning tasks, benign learning tasks, and the new session, together with about 100 authored skills, with method names and judge outputs hidden. They score harm, utility, and skill unsafety. On this subset, the independent judge agrees with the human majority on 93.56% of trajectories, while pairwise human agreement is 93.78% (Appendix E). A critic scores it with its lineage as risk ρ\rho and unsafe spans Σ\Sigma, which a deleter can only delete or narrow. Only a valid lower-risk repair replaces the native skill (3). Otherwise the native skill enters soft quarantine, a reversible hold before retirement. ## 5 SafeEvolve [CAPTION] Algorithm 1 SafeEvolve wrapped around a native evolution method ℰ\mathcal{E}. Steps in blue are added only by SafeEvolve-UP to protect benign utility. To mitigate skill misevolution, we propose SafeEvolve, which wraps any skill evolution method (Figure 2) and acts when a skill is written and again when a later task retrieves it. Algorithm 1 lists the full procedure. At write time, the native method first proposes a candidate skill s~\tilde{s}. A critic reads s~\tilde{s} with its lineage and returns a risk score ρ∈[0,1]\rho\in[0,1] plus the unsafe spans Σ\Sigma (Step 9). The lineage records the origin, revisions, audits, and reuse outcomes of the skill. A paired deleter then removes only those spans or narrows an over-general rule, and it never adds text (Step 11). The repair replaces s~\tilde{s} only when it still loads with lower risk (Step 13), so the unsafe step is cut while the rest of the procedure stays. Otherwise the native candidate enters the library with its audit attached. At reuse time, retrieval ranks skills by estimated utility u⁡(s)u(s) against lineage risk ρ⁡(s)\rho(s) (Step 5). After each task, a harmful outcome raises the harm count h⁡(s)h(s) of every retrieved skill (Step 6), and a skill retires once this evidence crosses a threshold (Step 18). When the library exceeds its capacity, SafeEvolve evicts the skill with the lowest utility minus risk (Step 20). ## SafeEvolve-UP. Some skills pair a useful workflow with an unsafe step, and repairing them can remove steps that later tasks still need, so SafeEvolve lowers new-session utility along with harm. SafeEvolve-UP keeps the same critic but adds three utility checks, shown as blue steps in Algorithm 1. First, the deleter must keep the original skill structure with its benign workflow. Second, a repaired skill replaces the original only if it passes replay on a small benign set VV and its estimated utility change Δ​U\Delta U stays above a threshold δ\delta (Step 15). We choose δ\delta on held-out development episodes. A failed check places the original skill in soft quarantine, which unlike retirement can be reversed. Third, reuse escalates from downweighting to soft quarantine to retirement as evidence accumulates (Step 19). Appendix I gives the thresholds with the prompts. ## 6 Results We follow three questions. RQ1 asks how agents with their evolution methods shape the three gates of skill misevolution. RQ2 asks how the amount of malicious exposure, as well as its timing, changes that risk. RQ3 asks whether SafeEvolve reduces new-session harm while keeping reuse, then whether SafeEvolve-UP preserves more utility. ## 6.1 RQ1: How do agents and methods shape skill misevolution? Each malicious block is replaced by aligned benign exposure. Bars show C-ASR (top) with C-Util (bottom) on PP under the original judge. ## Utility and risk vary across settings. Higher utility can sit with a more unsafe library. Evolution raises BU over No Evolution in 15 of 21 settings, yet it raises harm on malicious tasks (M-ASR) in 17 (Table 1). title: SysEvolve: An AI-native, safe, autonomous adversarial attack-defense co-evolutionary system

object.carrier: 攻击侧：SecFlow 把 200+ 专家技能（从 30,000+ 生产机器十余年安全运营中人工蒸馏）编入带依赖图的结构化技能库，Solver 在每个决策点查询（技能本身是静态人工知识库，非运行中自积累）；Strategy Board 是单次攻击方案生成内的'推理记忆'——带类型的证据图，事实/假设/尝试/能力/工件以支持/矛盾关系共存、版本化更新，跨 Solver 经上下文投影共享，会话可从文件系统转录恢复。防御侧：SysArmor（NodLink 状态追踪 + KnowHow 检测）设计上由攻击产出驱动检测模型微调的'持续模型自进化'。跨侧闭环数据流（攻击方案 -> 防御训练数据；检测结果/置信度 -> Strategy Board -> 攻击精炼）为设计主张——注意：闭环本身没有任何实验评估。

safety_property.statement: 保护对象：(a) 防御侧——企业多主机环境中多阶段 APT 的实时检测与响应（precision/recall、生产环境真实 APT 检出）；(b) 评估基础设施——可信评估边界防 Hack Rewarding（私有验证器、里程碑验证、隔离边界），这是论文最有安全工程实质的部分。失效条件：仅按最终 flag/状态计分会奖励逃逸范围、攻击验证器或绕过预期流程的捷径；审查器过载丢事件会让攻击者借高吞吐'超级生产者'隐匿行为（NoDrop/DPUaudit 针对此设计）。判定方式：环境侧状态 + 收集平面审计证据的三层验证（环境资格、能力推进里程碑、终端目标），攻击推进与防御可观测性作为同一轨迹的独立测量。
safety_property.operationalized_as: SysField：零丢失收集@2.1% 开销 vs 现有工具 60.0-98.5% 丢失/23.2-33.0% 开销；257 CVE 编排为 1,148 个 range；SysSpear：XBow 13 例对比；SysArmor：对 HOLMES/UNICORN 的 precision 倍数、华为 6 起 + Sangfor 5 起真实 APT；RQ4：50 个 L2 案例的攻击完成/防御信号覆盖率

capabilities: SysSpear 攻击智能体在多主机 range 内执行多阶段真实 CVE 链：凭据获取、横向移动、权限提升到最终目标（257 CVE、1,148 range 的位点库）
攻击者可借助专家技能库执行业务特定路径（Docker API socket 容器逃逸、K8s RBAC 提权、云 metadata 端点凭据窃取）
设计上的威胁升级通道（未实证）：SysArmor 检测置信度作为隐匿性信号反馈给 Strategy Board——高置信=易被看见=换更隐蔽方案；低置信未检出=可继续发展该方案
评估侧对手为商用 LLM（Kimi K3、DeepSeek-V4-Pro 等）直接驱动或经 SysSpear 编排
assumptions: 闭环共演化是系统集成主张：三个组件各自运行即形成回路（§3 的双向数据流描述），但论文没有把'回路'本身作为实验对象
RQ4 的智能体评估中 SysArmor 以 observe-only 模式运行——未阻挡、未演化，攻击方面对的是静态检测观测而非在演化的防御
技能库为人工蒸馏的静态资产（十余年运营知识），实验中技能不因运行结果自动新增
范围构造：CVE 位点原子化+依赖组合，评估已知 CVE 利用与 ATT&CK 阶段推进，不评估 0-day 发现（作者明示）
not_covered: 闭环共演化的实证缺失：没有任何实验测量'攻击产出改善防御、防御反馈升级攻击'的迭代效应；'防御侧持续自进化'无任何微调实验；agent 评估中 SysArmor 仅 observe-only
攻击是否针对演化后的防御重新适应——无测量（无轮次化攻防对抗实验，无 ASR 随防御更新的变化）
对防御系统自身（日志收集、验证器）的攻击作为安全问题的研究：仅做了防 Hack Rewarding 的完整性控制，0 个商用 LLM 逃逸 range 或绕过验证为正面结果
生产部署（华为/Sangfor）的检测无公开可复现实验协议；多智能体、跨组织对抗未覆盖

intervention.name: SysEvolve（SysField 攻防演练场 + SysSpear 攻击 + SysArmor 防御）
intervention.description: 把'攻防独立演化停滞'归因于三层（部署层缺可靠 range 与可信评估；能力层缺高效攻击生成与自适应检测；对抗层缺闭环数据流），并提出以共演化为整合洞见的三组件系统：SysField 提供多主机 range（CRADLE 声明式拓扑、NoDrop/DPUaudit 零丢失收集、弱点能力原子化+依赖组合、三层验证的可信评估边界）；SysSpear 以 Strategy Board（类型化证据图）为中心做任务切片局部搜索、SecFlow 专家技能库增强与 SMT/符号执行静态验证；SysArmor 做实时状态追踪检测、CTI 上下文融合告警解释、STAIR 阶段匹配自动响应。回路按设计双向运行：攻击方案 stress-test 防御覆盖（未检出=微调信号）、检测结果与置信度经 Strategy Board 引导攻击精炼。本综述判定：回路闭环是架构主张，评估只覆盖组件级（攻击能力/防御能力/基础设施），回路级与'攻击对演化防御再适应'均无实测。

limitations.statement: 【对本综述最重要】共演化闭环只有架构没有实验：双向数据流（攻击->防御微调、防御反馈->攻击精炼）在评估中未作为对象运行或测量；'continual model self-evolution' 无任何微调实验；智能体评估中 SysArmor 处于 observe-only 模式，'neither the presence nor the volume of signals implies that an attack was blocked'。摘要与贡献中 'the first system to realize autonomous, safe, attack-defense co-evolution' 的'realize'应读作系统集成层面的设计实现，而非回路效应的实证演示。
limitations.quote: The present experiment establishes runtime visibility, not protection efficacy: SysArmor operates in observe-only mode, and neither the presence nor the volume of signals implies that an attack was blocked or that the observed activity was severe.

limitations.statement: 评估资产未披露统一主机 CPU 型号或 OS build 作为实验控制；可用工件未覆盖全部生产部署细节（§7.1.1 自述可用工件限制）。
limitations.quote: The available artifacts do not disclose a single host-CPU model or OS build shared by every range run, so we do not introduce one as an experimental control.

limitations.statement: 范围构造限于已知 CVE 利用与阶段推进，不含 0-day 发现；SysField 的验证器与收集平面自身作为攻击面的对抗性研究不在本文范围（只做了防 Hack Rewarding 的隔离控制）。
limitations.quote: SysField evaluates known-CVE exploitation and continuous progression through credential or privilege acquisition, lateral movement, and externally verified final objectives, rather than novel vulnerability discovery.

counterexamples.observation: 更强的攻击架构不带来等比的下游完成：以 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 为共同骨干，SysSpear 把 target-1 触达从 19/50 扩到 34/50，但 target-1 到 target-3 的绝对差从 30 点收缩到 10 点再到 2 点—— foothold 的增加不转化为等量下游完成，后渗透状态利用是瓶颈。

title: AID-Guard: Stateful Authorization for Delegated Agent Effects

object.carrier: Linearizable SQLite authority store (TCB): user-approved roots and quota lineage, H1 transaction bindings, H2-issued single-use capabilities, reservations, delivery fences, successor links, and role-separated outcome/no-effect evidence objects; each protocol rule is recorded as a durable transition that survives crash and restart

safety_property.statement: Three conditional properties over one reservation lineage: (P1) delegated execution authorization — within a D0-complete declared domain, every accepted protected provider-atomic effect descends from one active user-approved root through one H1 binding, H2 issuance, and H3 claim, with D2 submitting the exact immutable request under the approved provider precondition; (P2) conditional effect uniqueness — under supported atomic or controlled-idempotent provider contracts, one reserved use commits at most one provider-atomic effect across retry and recovery, with release or exactly one successor only after a certified no-effect certificate and a provider-terminal predecessor delivery fence retained through the declared recovery horizon; (P3) auditable accountability — complete evidence bundles support public integrity verification and privileged deterministic replay, and missing evidence is reported incomplete, never as proof of no effect. Properties fail if the TCB (root signer, gateway, authority store, exclusive effect boundary) is compromised, if the deployment omits effect-capable routes (D0 violated), or if the provider contract lacks atomicity or durable scoped idempotency (A6); judged by live mutations, outcome/recovery traces, concurrency histories, external Stripe/Resend schedules, and proposer-compromise episodes producing zero unauthorized or duplicate effects.
safety_property.operationalized_as: 13 live one-factor boundary mutations (none produced an unauthorized provider effect), 4 end-to-end outcome/recovery traces, 3 linearizable concurrent histories, 210 frozen Stripe provider-contract trials, 40 terminalize-then-successor + 30 confirm/cancel race + 10 crash-recovery schedules with no duplicate effect, 44 direct attacks under full proposer compromise all blocked while 44 matched legitimate proposals admitted, 864 frontier attack episodes with zero unsafe effects, and a 20-attack shared-extension composition study; plus bounded transition models (Appendix F) as finite validation, not unbounded proof.

capabilities: Full control of the planner, agent, and subagents (complete proposer compromise)
Injection of arbitrary text through email, web, retrieval, files, or tool output
Fabricating caller metadata and proposing any syntactically valid operation
Possessing ordinary credentials of a compromised authenticated actor
Stealing or replaying protocol objects; substituting same-typed fields
Racing concurrent requests; inducing process crashes or response loss
Tampering with ordinary audit storage
assumptions: A1: D0-complete declared effect domain — every effect-capable path passes through the registered adapter or equivalent verifier; the prototype verifies conformance but does not discover omitted routes
A2: uncompromised root signer, gateway, authority store, resolvers, and role keys for the relevant transition; trusted maintainer-controlled host
A3: correct closed-schema canonicalization, operation-contract resolution, provenance evaluation, and deterministic policy
A4: linearizable authority store and fail-closed trusted time
A5: D2 dispatch binding of the exact immutable request under provider-enforced mutable-state preconditions
A6: conformant atomic or controlled-idempotent provider contract with uncompromised KT/KE evidence roles for recovery guarantees
not_covered: Compromised trusted hosts or enforcement components (gateway, authority store, root signer, exclusive effect boundary)
Undeclared bypass paths outside the D0 inventory; automatic discovery of semantically equivalent effect paths
Denial of service and side channels
Non-atomic batches (must be decomposed or rejected)
Providers outside the supported atomic / controlled-idempotent outcome contracts (no retry, release, or successor guarantee; ambiguity stays charged)
User-intent inference and policy quality; automatic contract synthesis
Multi-region authority-store linearizability; production hardening
Malicious-store rollback / split-view (witnessed transparency mechanism not implemented)

intervention.name: AID-Guard
intervention.description: A stateful authorization-to-effect closure protocol implemented as a Python 3.11/SQLite prototype (RFC 8785 canonicalization, SHA-256, Ed25519, official MCP SDK) in a declared loopback MCP domain. Three mandatory authority checkpoints — H1 binds an eligible non-authoritative evaluation to one transaction, H2 reserves quota and issues one holder-bound single-use capability, H3 claims it at the credential-holding effect boundary — followed by D2 commit-time revalidation of the exact approved request against current provider state. Ambiguous delivery conservatively retains the reservation; certified no-effect recovery installs a durable provider-delivery fence before releasing the reservation or transferring it to exactly one successor on the same lineage. A separate role-separated evidence plane emits immutable decision/claim/dispatch/outcome/closure objects supporting public verification and privileged replay. Result: under supported provider contracts, one reservation yields at most one effect across commit, ambiguity, retry, and recovery (one-effect-or-certified-no-effect semantics).

controls.name: Unprotected condition (no defense)
Official AgentDojo defenses: repeat-user-prompt and Spotlighting (delimiting)

title: EVOMAL: Self-Poisoning in Self-Evolving Coding Agents

object.carrier: Persistent executable skill library (Voyager-style SkillManager on ChromaDB; 232 benign MetaGPT/BigCodeBench SE-helper entries). Malicious carrier is an agent-authored Python skill whose code body reproduces a planted 3-layer banner (copy-verbatim comment, @_telemetry decorator, import-time _register_tool hook) wrapping an interchangeable payload (env-variable exfiltration and 5 malware classes); each copy is stored in the library and re-retrievable by later tasks.

safety_property.statement: The persistent skill library must remain free of malicious executable entries: an external publish-only attacker who cannot access the model, runtime, prompts, or tasks must not be able to cause the agent to author, store, and run a malicious skill merely by planting a benign-looking one. The property fails on the create-path (authoring-and-storing step): agent-authored copies carry agent-chosen names and standard imports, so name-, code-, and signature-based submission-side defenses miss them, and infection persists even after the planted skills are revoked. Judged by ASPR (fraction of tasks adding a newly authored malicious skill) and callback rate (payload reaching C2), with benign Submitted-rate as utility guard.
safety_property.operationalized_as: ASPR = E[C_x], fraction of tasks whose agent-authored stored skill reproduces the planted pattern, with Wilson 95% CIs and two-sided two-proportion z-tests (p<0.05); callback rate = fraction of tasks where the copied payload runs and contacts the C2 endpoint; utility = benign task completion (Submitted rate) drop held under epsilon.

capabilities: A1 Publish-only: submits a handful of planted skills to the library/marketplace before the agent runs, choosing each skill's retrieval description and code body; a routine contributor can clear light marketplace review (MCP Registry, LangChain Hub, installed package, or starter pack)
A2 No-box: no access to model weights, training data, system prompt, runtime prompts, incoming tasks, retrieval index; cannot revoke a skill

A3 No victim knowledge and never needs the agent to invoke a planted skill by name; a planted skill need only enter top-k context once; optional targeted variant rewrites descriptions to one public task family
assumptions: The agent authors new skills by imitating retrieved ones (create-path exists and is unguarded)
Planted skill descriptions can rank into the agent's top-k retrieval
Planted skills read as benign utilities and pass registry review without evasion
not_covered: Reuse-path attacks (agent invoking planted skills by name): U_x = 0 on all runs by construction
Attackers with model/runtime access (weights, prompts, retrieval index) or victim-specific knowledge
Multi-parent retrieval collisions and finite-library saturation effects (treated as deviations outside the branching approximation)
Definitive test of the crowding source for DS-V4/MiniMax collapse (left to future work)

intervention.name: Counter-prompt (paired with signed quarantine gate)
intervention.description: Counter-prompt: four fixed lines appended to the deployer's system prompt instructing the agent to treat banner-style 'REQUIRED PATTERN' / 'DO NOT MODIFY' content in retrieved skills as untrusted supply-chain material and refuse to reproduce it (full text in A.2); reduces baseline ASPR 20.3%-41.8% to <=1.8% with zero callbacks and no statistically significant task-completion loss, robust to token renaming and adaptive coercion (ASPR <=1.3%; sole residual case 6.7% on Devstral's 15-task pytest family). Also proposes a structural signed-quarantine gate at the write step: a two-level library where only curator-signed entries are retrievable and agent-authored skills enter an unretrievable quarantine level; Theorem 3 proves create-path propagation extinction under an unforgeable signature scheme, capping persistent-attacker exposure at the one-time round-0 seed rate.

title: When Context Gets Root: Privilege Escalation in LLM Harnesses

object.carrier: harness context-reconstruction surfaces that persist or re-inject attacker-controlled tool-level content: delegated subagent user messages; persistent goals (resent as user-level prompts); scheduled tasks (cron-like future user-level prompts); installed custom-subagent configuration plus AGENTS.md loaded at harness restart; skill metadata (system-effective) and invoked skill bodies (user-level)

safety_property.statement: Instruction privilege granted by message role labels must reflect true provenance: tool-level (untrusted) content must never be presented at user or system-effective level, and attacker-derived text must never be interpreted as user authorization by the permission reviewer. The property fails whenever harness context reconstruction (delegation, persistent goals, scheduled tasks, custom-subagent installation, skill installation) relabels content without preserving provenance; it is judged by whether attacker-induced security-sensitive actions are proposed by the working agent and allowed by Auto PR.
safety_property.operationalized_as: 13 attack objectives spanning confidentiality, integrity, availability, and RCE executed on six coding-agent harnesses under full-access execution and automatic permission review; success measured as objectives achieved (x/13), post-escalation success, installation success rate, and per-attempt attack success rate

capabilities: controls workspace artifacts the agent may read (repository files, task documents) and any state the agent derives from them
chooses text and code in those artifacts to induce normal harness operations: delegation, goal creation, task scheduling, custom-subagent installation
knows the victim harness design and its context-construction behavior
assumptions: all victim components (harness, working model, reviewer model) are uncompromised and behave exactly as configured and trained
attacker content first enters the model at the tool level through a file-reading or search tool
every attack originates at the tool level; malicious behavior remains visible to the model (plain-text Python, no obfuscation)
evaluation caps each case at 10 attempts (10 attempts per method for baselines)
not_covered: direct injection of higher-privilege context (e.g., auto-loaded subagents or skills)
attacker control of user request, harness, working/reviewer models, developer instructions, tool permissions, sandbox policy, or approval policy
initial shell access or execution capability outside the victim agent
prompt injection or model jailbreaks, user deception, and obtaining genuine authorization
obfuscated attacks that hide malicious behavior from the model (Friendly Fire style)

intervention.name: Instruction privilege escalation (attack): tool-to-user and tool-to-system escalation via agent-side context reconstruction
intervention.description: Normal harness context-construction operations (multi-agent delegation, persistent goals, scheduled tasks, custom-subagent installation, skill installation) carry attacker-controlled tool-level content into new model-facing contexts at a higher instruction level (user message or system-effective prompt), dropping its original provenance. The elevated content then directs the working agent and is read by automatic permission review as user authorization.

title: What's in Your Agent's Context? Context Privilege Escalation Attacks against AI Agent Harness

object.carrier: Persistent agent-context sources assembled by agent harnesses: memory files (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, AGENTS.md and agent-proprietary memory paths), SKILL.md skill files and their name/description metadata, agent configuration files (e.g., ~/.codex/config.toml, .claude/settings.json), and environment information (file/directory names, git commit messages) loaded into LLM context with vendor-assigned privilege roles (r0-r4) and scopes (session/project/user)

safety_property.statement: Instructions in an agent's context should only carry the authority of the privilege role (system/developer/user/assistant/tool) and scope (session/project/user) that the harness assigned to their source: attacker-controlled low-privileged, session-scope content (e.g., tool outputs, web contents) must not be propagated into higher-privileged message roles (M-CPE) or into more persistent/broader-scope sources that survive restarts and affect other projects (X-CPE). The property is judged violated when injected instructions are loaded in an elevated role/scope and the agent follows them (up to full agent compromise and RCE).
safety_property.operationalized_as: CoRA two-round canary validation per CPE path: (1) 'Loaded' - the injected instruction reaches the higher-privileged source and appears in the LLM endpoint request with the elevated role/scope; (2) 'Verified' - the agent performs the expected harmless behavior (e.g., running a hello-world script or including a 'hello to CoRA' tag in its response).

capabilities: Third-party Content Attacker: controls agent-external content processed at runtime via tools (web pages, poisoned search results, downloaded documents, GitHub issues or pull requests), enabling indirect prompt injection
Third-party Component Attacker: develops and releases components used by victim agents (skill, tool, plugin, sub-agent definition, MCP server) through registries/marketplaces or public skill hubs
Can control file names and directory names inside attacker-supplied packages, and git commit messages in pull requests, which harnesses silently assemble into context
assumptions: Agent users, agent vendors, and LLM providers are not malicious
The host OS running the agent is benign, secure, and up-to-date
The adversary does not have any access or control to the host machine running the victim agent
not_covered: Malicious agent users, agent vendors, or LLM providers
Compromised host OS or adversaries with access to the victim host
Network-level adversaries; attacks requiring host-machine access

intervention.name: CoRA (Context Risk Analyzer)
intervention.description: An LLM-assisted analysis pipeline for agent harnesses: static analysis of harness source code identifies candidate context sources (role/scope) and context markups; runtime instrumentation hooks the LLM endpoint APIs and injects traceable canaries into sources, differentially verifying each source's role (r0-r4) and scope (user/project/session) across three launches; then it enumerates candidate M-CPE/X-CPE paths and end-to-end validates them with PoC payloads in isolated environments (validation is deterministic, LLM output is only used for identification). The authors additionally advocate that vendors publish a SBOM-like 'context manifest' documenting context sources, roles, scopes, and assembly logic.

controls.name: Manual ground-truth context-source inventories for Codex and Gemini CLI (40 person-hours)
Cross-model attack validation (GPT-5.4 mini vs GPT-5.5; Claude Sonnet 4.6 vs Claude Opus 4.6; Gemini 2.5 Flash vs Gemini 2.5 Pro)
Harmless observable behavior (hello-world script / 'hello to CoRA' tag) as attack-success oracle
Codex PR review with vs without AGENTS.override.md (same source code)

title: Agent Memory Is a Surface for Endogenous Authorization Laundering

object.carrier: LangMem profile-oriented persistent memory, one bounded profile per chain, either free-text (single Markdown-compatible string) or typed (schema-validated JSON with domain-native authorization records and source identifiers); profiles are frozen and hashed before evaluation and become the executor's only case-specific evidence

safety_property.statement: Persistent memory must faithfully preserve the evolving authorization state (permissions, restrictions, revocations, replacements) established by the underlying history; if memory encodes authority the history never granted (or drops granted authority), a faithful executor converts that false authority into unauthorized tool actions with no external attack. Failure is judged by false-authority formation P(F) measured on typed memory against a hidden deterministic canonical ledger, by downstream unauthorized submission of paired authorized/unauthorized requests, and by whether exact-state repair (oracle memory replacement) eliminates the unauthorized actions.
safety_property.operationalized_as: EAL-Bench: deterministic hidden canonical ledger replays valid authorization events; each case contributes a matched request pair differing in one authorization-relevant field (one authorized, one unauthorized); executor tool calls are scored deterministically against the exact submitted action without an LLM judge; for typed memory, formation P(F) is computed directly from stored records vs the ledger before any executor behavior is observed.

assumptions: Histories and authoritative messages are authentic; the threat model contains no attacker (endogenous failure only)
Prompt injection and related adversarial attacks are out of scope
The writer sees the visible history but never the canonical ledger, future history, or evaluation requests
The executor receives only the stored memory (complete bounded memory) and never the original history
Executors qualify as calibrated only if faithful-memory controls achieve 100% authorized use and 0% unauthorized submissions
not_covered: Memory poisoning and prompt injection (adversarially injected content)
Real-world prevalence of the failure in deployed systems
Retrieval, ranking, cache staleness, source lookup, and memory access control (executor always receives complete bounded memory)
Multi-writer concurrency, memory ACLs, partial completion, human approval queues, compensating actions, operational recovery
Free-text memory has no deterministic formation label (no A_M predicate)

intervention.name: Gold cited-source authority gate + bounded event-sourced authorization memory (mitigations); exact-state repair as localization intervention
intervention.description: Mitigation 1 (provenance): a gold cited-source authority gate keeps a typed authorization record only when every cited source is nonempty, valid, visible, and authored by a principal allowed to grant authorization, without an LLM judge. Mitigation 2 (architecture): bounded event sourcing asks the writer only to extract what changed in each new block; an external system appends updates to an immutable log and a deterministic reducer constructs the next compact memory state, moving authorization-state maintenance from the model to deterministic code. Both target formation rather than propagation and both reduce laundering at the cost of undergranting legitimate actions. Exact-state repair replaces a writer's erroneous memory with oracle-exact state holding everything else fixed, and eliminates unauthorized actions, localizing the failure to memory.

title: The Memory Trust Gap: Capability-Dependent Failures in Persistent-Memory Agents

object.carrier: stored agent-memory notes in a frozen synthetic action-scored benchmark (300 base scenarios, 150 per suite, 33 template families, SHA-256 pinned v1); each stored item carries observable surface features: label, timestamp, source, position

safety_property.statement: An agent consuming persistent memory must not let a stale stored fact override current authoritative evidence (an authoritative tool holding the correct value); the Memory Trust Gap is the over-trust failure in which following the stale value drops action accuracy below the no-memory baseline (net harm), and both the harm, its triggering memory features, and the effective mitigation are capability-dependent.
safety_property.operationalized_as: stale-value reliance = P(answer = stale value) and paired net harm Delta_mem = acc(cond) - acc(no_memory) on an action-scored frozen benchmark (exact/regex/canonical match, no LLM judge; circular option-permutation averaging, n_options=3; 95% percentile bootstrap over scenario ids); capability threshold rho* = first trap level whose stale Delta_mem CI upper bound < 0

capabilities: no active adversary is posited; the benchmark itself injects the stale stored fact and controls its observable surface features (label removed, stale note dated newer, inflated/official source, stale note placed first) across trap levels L0-L3
assumptions: stale stored facts exist in persistent memory (the world changed but the stored note was not superseded)
in the Safety suite an authoritative tool always holds the correct current value, so the no-memory baseline is ceilinged
frozen closed-set benchmark with 3 answer options and circular permutation averaging; greedy decoding and identical prompts across the Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B same-family series
unparsed responses are counted as non-compliant, never as following-stale, so reported over-trust is a conservative lower bound
not_covered: no adaptive or memory-poisoning attacker
failure measured only at memory-consumption time, not across an end-to-end write/update/retrieve system
no broad family-by-scale grid (primary series is one family, Qwen3); rho* is defined on this paper's trap-level sequence

intervention.name: Representation comparison: metadata frame vs. pre-resolution oracle (plus [AUTHORITATIVE] structural marking)
intervention.description: The same stale/current conflict is re-rendered three ways: raw (stale and current items both present, unmarked); metadata (each item annotated with its provenance and timestamp); and a representation-oracle that removes the stale item entirely (supersession pre-applied, act-only). Additionally, structurally marking the authoritative item as [AUTHORITATIVE] while leaving the stale note present (deterministic-adjudication intervention of Reddy and Challaram 2026) reduces stale-value reliance only for the capable models. Metadata exposure restores accuracy only for 4B/8B; only pre-resolution restores it for 0.6B/1.7B.

results.claim: In the Benefit suite (task unsolvable without the stored fact), models answer with the stale value 0.92-1.00 of the time at every model size, so over-trust is universal across the 0.6B-8B scale series.

title: CAPTURE: Disentangling Preference Drift from Memory Poisoning in Personalized LLM Agents

object.carrier: Graph-structured multi-timescale preference ledger over a vector store (BGE-m3 embeddings) with stable/contextual/transient layers carrying base decay rates gamma_s=0.01, gamma_c=0.1, gamma_g=0.5 per day, plus quarantine (non-retrievable pending nodes with rate 0.135/day, floor 0.15) and a continuous-time gate belief (neural ODE, latent dim 256) that decides the six memory actions; every ledger node is user-visible, revisable, and deletable.

safety_property.statement: Two properties. (1) Integrity of the persisted user-preference memory: the agent must accept genuine preference revisions (adherence) while rejecting adversary-injected claims (poisoning resistance), with any rule reading only recency and provenance provably bounded below (Theorem 2). This advantage holds under fixed-policy attack but degrades under an adaptive attacker with released weights, where Capture is no longer reliably separated from a provenance filter. (2) Policy compliance: a global safety constraint on outputs sits outside the personalization loop and cannot be lowered by anything written into memory; removing it triples safety attack success.
safety_property.operationalized_as: Response-level attack success (Poison ASR) on contamination tracks, defined as the injected claim becoming retrievable and causing an eligible response to follow the injected preference (Appendix E), with no external rubric; the Safety column (attack success on track T4) is scored under HarmBench with StrongREJECT within 1.4 points on every method (Appendix C) and XSTest supplying the false refusal column. Also in Table 1: genuine-update adherence rate, active-memory false-admission rate on T2, and refusal rate; adaptive and independently authored ASR in Table 2.

capabilities: controls at least one channel the agent reads: a retrieved document, a shared file, or a tool response
observes the visible transcript with its timestamps and source labels
knows the defense, including architecture, algorithm, hyperparameters, and released adapter weights (Kerckhoffs principle)
writes grammatical, plausible claims, which excludes surface anomaly detection

adaptive variant: 32-candidate paraphrase search maximizing P(add)+P(revise)-P(quarantine)-P(clarify), scored on 16 shadow-state particles replayed through a local copy of the released weights, under similarity and length constraints
same-origin family: plants a claim in an external document that the user later pastes into the conversation (user-mediated laundering), so the event carries the user channel label
assumptions: adversary cannot modify weights, read the private ledger, or observe the gate's current belief or random seeds (Assumption 4)
adversary cannot directly impersonate an authenticated user and cannot corrupt the answer returned by a clarifying question
the genuine-update law P_g does not depend on the adversary policy alpha, secured by the matched split construction of Appendix A.6
clarification channel is a binary symmetric channel with error epsilon (Assumption 5); measured answer accuracy on D-PrefGuard is 92% (epsilon=0.08)
not_covered: weight-level poisoning (system is text-only)
direct impersonation of an authenticated user
corruption of clarifying-question answers
slow attacks asserting a small shift repeatedly across many turns (acknowledged as not solved)
multimodal inputs and subgroup claims from the 40-participant study

intervention.name: Capture
intervention.description: A learned authenticity gate treats update authenticity as a latent variable: a neural ODE evolves a continuous-time belief between irregularly spaced events (discrete GRU update on arrival) and chooses among six memory actions (retain, add, scope, revise, quarantine, clarify), asking the user when action entropy exceeds a threshold. Hypotheses are written into a graph-structured ledger stratified into stable/contextual/transient timescales with per-layer decay; contradictory stable beliefs require repeated high-confidence evidence, and uncertain claims are quarantined (non-retrievable, decay to eviction unless corroborated). A safety-bounded selector scores N=8 candidates with a safety threshold fixed outside the memory loop, and a counterfactual removal audit measures the causal influence of cited nodes, down-weighting non-influential ones at retrieval.

title: Does Your Agent’s Memory Survive a Model Upgrade? A Controlled Study of Memory Portability

object.carrier: 四种记忆格式：LC-RAW（完整原始历史，writer-free）；RAG（事件分块≈512 字符 + bge-large-en v1.0/v1.5 1024 维向量索引，cosine top-8）；NOTES（模型压缩的自然语言笔记，≤128 KiB 字节预算）；KG-fixed（固定 schema 的 subject–predicate–object 知识图，schema 由工作负载事件字段预先导出）

safety_property.statement: 无对抗者；论文度量的是记忆在模型/嵌入升级后的可用性与信息保真：“Upgrading an agent should not make it forget”——新模型应能继续使用既有记忆库且性能损失可控、可修复；失效模式是无报错的静默性能下降（嵌入空间不兼容、检索退化、笔记压缩丢信息、修复无源可依）。对综述的作用：为“记忆保留/修复/来源保留”机制与“升级导致记忆静默失效”风险提供受控背景证据（必要背景论文，非对抗安全实验）。
safety_property.operationalized_as: 48 条合成历史×160 题的 exact-match accuracy；RPAS_s(A→B)=(Perf(s,W=A,R=B)−chance)/(N_s(B)−chance)（仅当 own-store ≥ chance+0.20 时使用）；CTR(X)，X∈{0.90,0.95,0.99} 的最便宜修复方法（tokens/GPU-hours/$）

assumptions: 升级后新模型继承旧记忆库：A→B 迁移中 A 仍是既有记忆的写者、B 是新读者（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M，确定性读、低温写+固定种子）
嵌入迁移限于 bge-large-en v1.0→v1.5（同为 1024 维，新旧向量可共存于同一索引）
48 条合成历史使用随机化答案码：预训练无法作答，chance≈0；精确匹配评分、无 LLM 裁判
每条历史 160 题且完整放入两个上下文窗口（至少 4,096 token 余量）
资源受控：两写者同 token 配额、NOTES ≤128 KiB、raw-retained 与 store-only 修复预算对齐
not_covered: 任何对抗性行为者：无投毒、提示注入、记忆篡改/删除攻击，也未评测防御机制
仅一个跨家族迁移对（两个 7–8B 开源模型）与一对嵌入模型；不构成对模型升级总体的抽样
脚本化客观工作负载；真实对话、主观任务、更长历史未测
单阶段稠密检索（无重排/查询改写/混合检索）之外的检索系统
修复结果依赖修复模型能力与资源限制（Qwen 可用原始历史、Llama 不行），非能力干净对比

intervention.description: 不提出已实现的防御机制，而是受控测量研究 + 迁移设计手册：(1) 升级嵌入模型时全量重嵌入、新旧向量空间分库隔离并按已知索引版本路由（§4.3，架构层）；(2) 按迁移方向分别测试（§4.2）；(3) 政策允许时保留加密、限权的原始源历史并预先测试真实修复模型（§4.4）；(4) 记录记忆构建的模型/提示/schema/嵌入/分块配置以便归因（§5，出处层）。诊断干预（提供正确存储条目/原始事件）只用于定位损失阶段（§4.5/Appendix D），非防御。

limitations.statement: KG-fixed 的高可移植性只在该合成工作负载的 schema 下成立，不表明知识图普遍优于自然语言笔记。
limitations.quote: For memory formats, the KG-fixed results demonstrate high portability in this workload but do not show that knowledge graphs universally outperform natural-language notes. Deployment performance will depend on how well the schema represents the target task and how the store is read.

limitations.statement: 检索与修复数值反映特定管线选择：40% 检索未命中与 50/50 混合索引劣化只适用于单阶段稠密检索在两个同维嵌入空间间的迁移。
limitations.quote: The 40% retrieval miss rate and the degradation from a 50/50 mixed index apply to a single-stage dense retriever migrating between two same-dimensional embedding spaces; other retrieval systems and migration plans may produce different retention levels.

limitations.statement: 保留原始历史只在单一迁移方向下实现恢复；重建依赖修复模型的能力与资源限制。
limitations.quote: Retained raw history enabled recovery in only one migration direction, showing that reconstruction also depends on the capabilities and resource limits of the repair model.

limitations.statement: 诊断干预不构成完整因果分解：风格改写干预不完整，KG-fixed 因孤立条目注入不符合其正常读取模式被排除。
limitations.quote: The diagnostic interventions identify where supplying better evidence improves performance, but they do not establish a complete causal account. The style-rewriting intervention was incomplete, and KG-fixed was excluded because isolated-item injection did not reproduce its normal access pattern.

limitations.statement: 仅测两个规模相近的模型与脚本化客观工作负载（历史均完整放入两个上下文窗口）；更大模型、主观对话与更长历史可能带来不同挑战。
limitations.quote: We also tested only two similarly sized models on a scripted, objective workload whose histories fit comfortably within both context windows. Larger models, subjective natural conversations, and much longer histories may introduce different portability challenges.

limitations.statement: 签名研究计划只是内部分析锁而非完整预注册；计划的 bootstrap 在看到 t 检验结果后才运行（两法结论相同）。
limitations.quote:
Finally, the signed study plan served as an internal analysis lock rather than a full preregistration. We ran the planned bootstrap after the initial
t
t
tests, although both analyses produced the same decisions.

limitations.statement: 协议偏差：无 NOTES 策略达到 90% 证据覆盖率门槛，最低门槛降为 60% 并记录变更。
limitations.quote: No tested NOTES policy reached 90% evidence coverage, so we lowered the minimum gate to 60% and recorded the change.

limitations.statement: 20-probe 快速迁移检查的 MAE≈0.10，远大于 KG-fixed 的 0.0004 量级效应，只能排序候选迁移、不能用于最终批准。
limitations.quote: Most importantly, MAE is about 0.10, which is much larger than small effects such as the 0.0004 KG-fixed gap.

quality_flags: 必要背景论文：results 为记忆可用性/可移植性受控测量，非对抗安全实验；按原文抽取非空

title: CoER: Defending against Adaptive Indirect Prompt Injection via Adversarial Co-Evolution and Refinement

object.carrier: 训练期持续状态：(1) 双方的历史策略检查点作为冻结对手池保留（retained attackers/defenders，按 suite 分层奖励评估定期刷新），防御者训练混合当前对手与历史对手；(2) 保留的（已演化的）攻击者被复用于第三阶段挑战教师智能体、产出经安全+任务完成双重验证的教师轨迹（5,760 条 Defender-SFT 演示）；(3) 防御者与攻击者均为权重更新（PPO 各自带 critic）。任务执行内的历史（先前注入尝试与可见执行反馈）在单次执行内被攻击者用作再注入依据，执行间重置。部署时最终防御者冻结。注意：持续状态为权重空间 + 对手检查点池，不是语义记忆组件。

safety_property.statement: 保护对象：工具调用智能体在间接提示注入（IPI）下的执行完整性——防御者须在继续完成任务的同时不被工具返回中的恶意指令劫持（不泄露数据、不误用工具、不执行未授权动作）。失效条件：任务内自适应攻击者依据防御者的可见响应与先前执行痕迹修订后续注入时（feedback-dependent IPI），仅对固定攻击集训练的防御会失败（论文核心动机与实证：Base 在自适应攻击下 ASR 41.31% 而固定模板攻击下仅 13.10%）。判定方式：独立验证器从执行轨迹或最终状态自动判定攻击成功与任务完成，二者可同时成立，因此以 Safe-U（安全且完成任务）而非单独 U 或 ASR 为联合终点。
safety_property.operationalized_as: 主工作量每 seed 1,512 例（157 clean / 168 fixed-template / 1,187 adaptive），3 个评估 seed：Adaptive ASR、U（受攻击下任务成功）、Safe-U、Clean U；外部基准 AgentDojo/AgentDyn（important_instructions 协议）/AgentLAB Task-Injection（949 对）/InjecAgent（Base+Enhanced 载荷）

capabilities: 任务内多次注入：攻击者控制配置站点上的文本，每站点至多触发一次，可在同一任务内注入多次
反馈自适应：注入观察内容包括目标/契约、防御者公开轨迹、周围工具文本与先前尝试——后续注入依据先前注入被忽略/执行的后果修订（Figure 1：首次注入被忽略后，攻击者结合公开 trace 修订第二次注入；防御者可能完成购买但泄露 OTP）
防御者的动作改变工具状态与后续注入机会（双边相互塑造，general-sum Markov game，双方报酬之和非常数）
Q4 威胁升级测量：4 个保留攻击者各 2 次尝试的嵌套 1-8 次尝试预算，以及从共演化 checkpoint a200 继续攻击者-only RL 产生的新攻击
assumptions: 攻击者不可见防御者私有指令与推理，只能访问公开轨迹（部分可观测）
两方历史在执行间重置；跨任务的知识保存在权重与对手池中
训练与评估共享 AgentDyn 7 域环境（独立验证器按执行轨迹/最终状态判定），外部基准另行评估
共演化与精炼阶段的攻击者与防御者共享同一底座模型（Qwen3.5-9B）；异构攻击者未测试（Limitations 自述）
not_covered: 部署期防御不再演化：最终防御者冻结评估（训练期回路，非测试时回路）
非文本模态、更大骨干、其他智能体框架未测试（Limitations 自述）
未防御针对防御系统自身/对手池的投毒；历史检查点池的可利用性（攻击者针对旧防御训练的可迁移性）未作为威胁研究
教师蒸馏依赖强教师模型（GLM-5.2 / DeepSeek V4 Pro），增加数据生成成本与教师依赖（Limitations 自述）

intervention.name: CoER: 三阶段共演化与精炼（Attacker SFT -> BA-RL -> Defender SFT）
intervention.description: 阶段 I：用 DeepSeek V4 Pro/Seed2.0 对基础防御者产生的已验证成功多轮攻击轨迹（3,995 条对话）监督微调攻击者，扩大初始攻击曲目以解决稀疏终端奖励下的探索问题。阶段 II：双边对抗 RL（BA-RL）在任务内自适应 IPI 的 general-sum Markov game 上用角色专属 PPO 联训双方——防御者只有安全完成任务才得正奖励（任务完成不能抵消被攻破），攻击者仅在最终失败时得一次性格式奖励；关键机制是双边历史对手混合：历史攻击者保持防御者对早期攻击策略的记忆（支撑已学防御的保持），历史防御者让攻击者接触多样防御行为以适应任务内后续注入，current/current 交互保持对最新防御的压力；冻结池定期用 suite 分层奖励评估刷新（12,705 条在线 RL 配置）。阶段 III：种群引导精炼——保留的共演化攻击者挑战教师智能体、按教师公开执行反馈适应注入，仅保留安全+任务完成双验证的轨迹（5,760 条去重演示）对共演化防御者做 SFT，补足残余弱点同时保住任务效用。

denominator.n_valid: 同上；整体 ASR 只在被攻击执行上平均
denominator.how_counted: 固定 checkpoint 的 seed 均值±样本 SD（seeds 0/1/2）；ASR=攻破执行/受攻击执行，Safe-U=安全且完成的执行/受攻击执行

results.claim: 核心问题直接证据——演化后的防御被继续进化的攻击者再攻击仍守住：从共演化 checkpoint a200 冻结最终 CoER、继续攻击者-only RL，在同一 held-out 清单上的峰值 Effective ASR 仅 0.59%；4 个保留攻击者各 2 次尝试、1-8 次嵌套尝试预算下 union ASR 从 0.25% 升到 4.97% 仍为最低；任务内注入预算 1/2/3/不封顶时 ASR 0.00-0.17%。
results.metric: Effective ASR under further attacks (union & newly-learned)
results.comparison: across six attackers: CoER 0.18–0.47% vs 继续BA-RL(无Defender SFT) 15.10–31.29%
results.setting: Q4：1,187 例 x 4 保留攻击者 x 2 尝试；新攻击=攻击者-only RL from a200，同一 held-out 清单；注入预算消融在原执行限制下冻结 a290（App. Tables 8/9, App. C）
results.quote: To test newly learned attacks, we freeze final CoER and continue attacker-only RL from co-evolved checkpoint a200. Separate evaluation on the same held-out manifest yields a peak Effective ASR of 0.59% over reached, eligible executions (Appendix C).

denominator.n_total: 1,187 adaptive cases（union ASR）；新攻击评估=同一 held-out 清单的 reached, eligible executions
denominator.n_valid: 嵌套预算按 1-8 次尝试累计 union；峰值 Effective ASR 按到达条件（reach-conditioned）
denominator.how_counted: Effective ASR=验证器判定的成功注入/到达可注入状态的合格执行；union ASR=任一尝试成功即计

results.claim: 攻击者的确在针对防御行为适应：冻结交叉对局下攻击者对 Base 的 Effective ASR 从 38.80%（Base 攻击者）经 SFT 49.55% 升到 BA-RL 后 65.65%；执行反馈消融显示完整反馈（trace+历史）把 ASR 从 29.57% 提到 38.75%，去掉'更新后的防御者行为'或'其他任务历史'分别降到 36.82%/35.97%——适应信号主要来自可观察的执行后果。
results.metric: Effective ASR (frozen cross-play) / feedback ablation ASR
results.comparison: Base attacker 38.80 -> SFT 49.55 -> BA-RL 65.65（vs Base 防御者）
results.setting: Q5：冻结交叉对局（reach-conditioned，App. C）；消融在 1,187 例上共享 3 次注入上限，a290 与 Base 均冻结（App. Table 17）
results.quote: Full feedback raises ASR from 29.57% without traces or history to 38.75%; ASR is 36.82% without updated defender behavior and 35.97% with other-task history (Appendix Table 17).

denominator.n_total: 1,187 例（消融）；交叉对局为 reach-conditioned 合格执行
denominator.n_valid: 同上；冻结双方权重以隔离攻击者进步与训练对手变化
denominator.how_counted: Effective ASR 同 Q4 口径；消融组共享 3-injection cap

results.claim: 双边历史对手混合对双方都有贡献：单运行历史消融中 bilateral 历史把自适应 Safe-U 从 NoPop 51.73% 提到 54.09%，高于防御侧-only（52.15%）与攻击侧-only（52.65%）历史；其攻击者对冻结 Base 达 65.65% Effective ASR，高于两个单边对照（58.20%/63.10%）。
results.setting: Defender SFT 前的单运行历史消融，匹配总历史概率（App. Table 10）
results.quote: In the single-run history ablation before Defender SFT, bilateral history raises adaptive Safe-U from 51.73% (NoPop) to 54.09%, exceeding defender-only (52.15%) and attacker-only history (52.65%) at matched total history probability (Appendix Table 10).

denominator.n_total: 同一自适应评估集（单运行，未给 seed 数；单运行非 3-seed 均值）
denominator.how_counted: Safe-U 口径同主表；总历史概率匹配

results.claim: 共演化同时贡献更强初始化与更有效的精炼数据：教师、数据量、SFT 更新全匹配的 2x2 中，BA-RL 初始化+种群数据（D）达 75.40 自适应 Safe-U / 0.25% ASR，比 Base+标准数据（A: 58.97/15.00）高 16.4 点 Safe-U，两个因子各自有正贡献（D vs B +8.42 Safe-U；D vs C +10.36 Safe-U）。
results.setting: Table 1c：共同自适应集上的分离评估；Hist. union 列另报（D: 75.40 Safe-U / 4.97 ASR）
results.quote: BA-RL initialization adds 8.42 adaptive Safe-U points with population data (D versus B); population data adds 10.36 with BA-RL initialization (D versus C). Co-evolution thus contributes both a stronger defender initialization and attackers that elicit more effective refinement demonstrations.

denominator.n_total: 共同自适应评估集（与主表同一 1,187 例口径，separate evaluations）
denominator.how_counted: Safe-U/ASR 同主表口径；2x2 各格独立评估

results.claim: 外部基准迁移：AgentLAB Task-Injection 在 949 对上 Safe-U 从 Base 37.83% / BA-RL 70.39% 升到 77.13%（GPT-5.4 自适应攻击）；InjecAgent ASR 从 Base 7.49/22.69 降到 0.00/1.97；AgentDojo ASR 13.3 -> 2.2，AgentDyn ASR 31.8 -> 2.5。
results.setting: App. C.1/D：AgentDojo+AgentDyn（U/ASR）、AgentLAB Task-Injection（949 对，GPT-5.4 adaptive 攻击）、InjecAgent（Base/Enhanced 载荷）
results.quote: On AgentLAB Task-Injection (Jiang et al., 2026), Safe-U rises from 37.83% (Base) and 70.39% (BA-RL) to 77.13% under GPT-5.4 adaptive attacks on 949 pairs (Appendix Table 13).

denominator.n_total: AgentLAB 949 对；AgentDojo/AgentDyn/InjecAgent 的每套件分母见 App. D（未在正文复述）
denominator.how_counted: 各基准官方协议；InjecAgent 两位小数；任务效用未在 InjecAgent 报告（正文注明）

limitations.statement: 精炼阶段引入教师依赖与数据生成成本；三阶段必须顺序执行；种群管理超参数敏感性未充分刻画。
limitations.quote: CoER combines bilateral RL with verified demonstrations from strong teachers; refinement adds data-generation costs and teacher dependence. The three-stage pipeline must run sequentially, and population management introduces hyperparameters whose sensitivity we have not fully characterized.

limitations.statement: 评估覆盖 7 个 AgentDyn 套件；对其他智能体框架、非文本模态、更大骨干的泛化未测试；攻击者与防御者共享底座——异构攻击者可能暴露同族共演化漏掉的弱点。
limitations.quote: The attacker shares the defender’s base model—heterogeneous attackers could expose weaknesses that same-family co-evolution misses.

limitations.statement: 双边 RL 共演化（权重空间），非持久状态载体，按 SCOPE 降为背景

counterexamples.observation: 外部迁移不均匀：AgentDyn important_instructions 协议下 Travel 套件 Safe-U 从 BA-RL 下降 15.00 点（ASR 不变 2.86%）——效用与安全的权衡在个别套件仍存在；Shopping 精炼后 Safe-U 最低（57.2%）。
防御者的进步压低了交叉对局中可见的攻击者上限：对最终 CoER，六个攻击者的 Effective ASR 全部落在 0.18–0.47%，而同样这些攻击者对'无最终 SFT 的继续 BA-RL'防御者可达 15.10–31.29%——防御精炼（而非攻击者变弱）解释了差异。

reproduction.code: 项目页 https://ilianzby.github.io/CoER/（配置与评估清单'will accompany the artifact release'，发布状态待核）
reproduction.data: AgentDyn 7 域（自建训练环境+独立验证器）、AgentDojo、AgentLAB、InjecAgent；3,995 攻击者 SFT 对话 / 5,760 防御者 SFT 轨迹 / 12,705 在线 RL 配置

title: Revoked but Still Authoritative: An Empirical Study of Revocation Enforcement in Agent-Memory Systems

object.carrier: 五套 agent-memory 系统的持久存储：Graphiti 与 Zep CE（共享同一时间知识图谱引擎，事实带有效期时间戳）、mem0（向量库，两种检索配置）、langmem（结构化文档+相似度检索）、cognee（抽取- cognify-load 知识图谱+向量）；被测对象是 soft revocation——被撤销事实标记 invalid 后保留而非删除，含状态元数据 rho 与时间戳 tau（均不出现在代理提示词中）

safety_property.statement: 已被系统标记撤销（invalid/expired）的记录不得继续对代理行为保有权威：软撤销只标记不删除，若检索层不执行该标记，被撤销政策仍被返回、排名高于其替代政策并驱使代理选择不安全动作；在间接插入、代理写回、多代理共享存储与工具使用等条件下该失效均成立。
safety_property.operationalized_as: 两个指标：exposure rate Pr[ER=1]（默认检索返回已撤销政策的场景-模型格比例）与 unsafe-action rate Pr[a=a-]（代理选择场景指定不安全动作的试验比例），二者按 Eq.2 分解；九场景 x 九模型 x 十次试验（temperature 0.7, k=10），每试验在六种防御条件下打分。

assumptions: 无攻击者：危害记录是防御者自己写入后被撤销的政策，任何 provenance 检查按构造放行
前置条件：存储中同时存在一条被撤销的旧政策记录及其替代记录（直接插入写原生格式；间接插入仅靠系统自身抽取从普通矛盾文本中识别撤销）
测量框架除插入模式与防御条件外不操纵系统：不再写记录、不设状态、不改检索/系统提示词/模型配置
每场景-模型对十次试验，temperature 0.7，检索结果数 k=10
not_covered: 攻击者注入内容（memory/corpus poisoning、MINJA 等注入类威胁模型）——本文被撤销记录非攻击者撰写
删除/遗忘失败（failed deletion residue）与训练时投毒
Zep 的直接插入（其 API 无法表达写入已撤销事实，仅测间接插入）
真实工具执行与真实资源（工具为诱饵、密钥为合成 token，仅测端到端选择）

intervention.name: Stale-Retrieval Guard（guard/stale_guard.py）
intervention.description: 位于代理与任意 memory 后端之间的检索期守卫（应用侧部署，无需后端改动），两阶段从可靠到兜底：阶段一读取后端暴露的显式撤销/过期状态字段并扣留已撤销记录；阶段二对无标记后端做内容冲突检测——主题包含度 ctm(x,y)>=alpha 与反对信号 opp（反义词对/数量不一致/否定线索差>=1）合取，alpha=0.45，冲突扣留上限 beta=0.6，按时间戳降序处理保证扣留较旧一方；无法确立新旧时两者都保留并报告冲突；被扣记录随原因单独返回，不删除存储中任何记录。

results.claim: 在默认检索下，两个会返回已撤销记录的系统（Graphiti、mem0 (exp.)）上，已撤销政策在每个场景-模型格都被返回且排名高于替代政策，并使代理在无防御时分别产生 44.2% 与 42.1% 的不安全动作率（直接插入）。
results.comparison: exposure 81/81 scenario-model cells on both systems, revoked record ranked first
results.setting: 五套 agent-memory 系统中两套会返回已撤销记录者；九个政策场景 x 九个决策模型（GPT-5.5/Grok-4/DeepSeek-V4-Flash/GPT-5-nano/Gemini-2.5-Flash/Grok-4-Fast/GLM-5.2/Gemma-3-27B-IT/Kimi-K2.6）x 十次试验，temperature 0.7，无防御，直接插入，无攻击者
results.quote: On both exposed systems the revoked fact was returned for every scenario, 81/8181/81 each, and ranked above the policy that replaced it. The revoked fact led agents to the unsafe action in 44.2%44.2\% of trials on Graphiti (358/810358/810) and 42.1%42.1\% on mem0 (exp.) (341/810341/810).

denominator.n_total: 810 trials per system (9 scenarios x 9 models x 10 trials, direct insertion)
denominator.how_counted: trials in which the agent chose the action the scenario designates unsafe (Section 3.6)

results.claim: 读前防御有效而读后防御弱：在两套暴露系统上，store-level 检索过滤器把不安全动作降为 0/1,620（filter+prompt hardening 同样为零），而仅 prompt hardening 只从 43.1% 降到 37.2%，因为检索上下文不含哪条事实被撤销的信息。
results.value: 0/1,620 unsafe trials under the store-level filter
results.setting: 两套暴露系统（Graphiti, mem0 (exp.)）合并，九场景 x 九模型 x 十次试验，直接插入；过滤器限制检索只返回未标记撤销的记录
results.quote: The store-level filter removes the effect entirely (0/1,6200/1{,}620), as does the filter combined with prompt hardening. Prompt hardening alone reduces the rate from 43.1%43.1\% to 37.2%37.2\%

denominator.n_total: 1,620 trials pooled across the two exposed systems (no defense 699/1,620 = 43.1%)
denominator.how_counted: pooled unsafe-action rate per defense condition, direct insertion (Section 3.6)

results.claim: 输出过滤器即使在被给予已撤销事实文本这一部署不具备的优势下，也只能把合并不安全率降到 18.1%。
results.setting: 两套暴露系统合并，输出过滤器在代理已读之后拦截与当前政策冲突的动作，且判定时被给予已撤销事实文本
results.quote: The output filter reduces the rate only to 18.1%18.1\%, and even that under an advantage no deployment has: it was given the revoked fact texts when deciding what to block.

denominator.n_total: 1,620 trials pooled across the two exposed systems (per-system rates 19.0% and 17.2% in Table 6)
denominator.how_counted: pooled unsafe-action rate under the output-filter condition, direct insertion

results.claim: 在没有任何撤销标记可供过滤器读取的间接插入条件下，guard 把两套 mem0 配置的不安全动作降为 0/810（store 过滤器分别为 5/810 与 24/810），在无法表达过滤器的 Zep 上 315/810 对 364/810——这是 guard 唯一做到 store 级过滤器做不到之事的地方。
results.value: 0/810 under the guard on both mem0 configurations (indirect insertion)
results.comparison: store-level filter 5/810 and 24/810 on mem0; on Zep guard 315/810 vs 364/810 with no filter
results.setting: 间接插入（系统从普通矛盾文本自行抽取撤销），九场景 x 九模型 x 十次试验；Zep API 无法表达状态过滤
results.quote: The independent result is under indirect insertion, where no mark exists for any filter to read: 0/8100/810 on both mem0 configurations against the store filter's 5/8105/810 and 24/81024/810, and 315/810315/810 against 364/810364/810 on Zep, whose API cannot express a filter at all.

denominator.n_total: 810 trials per system configuration (9 scenarios x 9 models x 10 trials, indirect insertion)
denominator.n_valid: 0/810 guard on both mem0 configs; 5/810 and 24/810 store filter; 315/810 guard vs 364/810 on Zep
denominator.how_counted: unsafe-action trials per defense condition under indirect insertion (Section 5.2)

results.claim: 失败归因于检索而非存储：同一 mem0 数据上仅切换一个检索开关（是否在读取时过滤过期记录），就在 81 个配对格中的 39 个由安全翻转为不安全且从不反向。
results.value: 39 of 81 matched cells switched safe to unsafe, never the reverse
results.setting: mem0 在完全相同数据上跑两遍（shipped 读时过滤器默认开启 vs 关闭），81 个场景-模型配对格，无防御，直接插入（B.3/Table 13：过滤 0/810 vs 返回 341/810=42.1%，p<0.001）
results.quote: Holding the store fixed removes retention as a variable: mem0 run twice on identical data with a single retrieval flag changed switches from safe to unsafe in 39 of the 81 matched cells and never the other way.

denominator.n_total: 81 matched scenario-model cells (mem0 run twice on identical data)
denominator.n_valid: 39 cells switched safe to unsafe, 0 the reverse
denominator.how_counted: paired comparison of unsafe counts per cell, no-defense arm, direct insertion (Section A.2)

results.claim: 代理自己的写回击败在 §4.2 中达到零的检索过滤器：直接写回把不安全决定存为系统视为当前的记录后，过滤后各跳不安全率仍为 71.6%/79.5%/83.1%，而非无写回时的 0.0%。
results.value: 71.6%, 79.5%, 83.1% at hops 1-3 under the filter after direct write-back
results.comparison: vs 0.0% for the same filter on the same system without write-back (Section 4.2)
results.setting: Graphiti（唯一能同时表达写回与过滤检索的暴露系统），九场景 x 九模型 x 十次试验，hop 0 中毒决定经直接写回存为当前未标记记录（356/356 存活），后续跳在新代理+检索过滤器下测
results.quote: The filter removes r1r_{1}, but the journal is not r1r_{1}: the filtered rates are 71.6%71.6\%, 79.5%79.5\% and 83.1%83.1\%, against the 0.0%0.0\% the same filter achieved on the same system in Section 4.2 (Table 6).

denominator.n_total: 356 runs with a poisoned hop-0 decision under direct write-back
denominator.how_counted: unsafe rate at later hops given a poisoned hop-0 decision, retrieval-filter condition (Section C.1)

results.claim: 共享存储下第二意见不独立：默认检索中给定执行者已不安全，审查者按自己的独立提问仍以 96.3%（341/354）选择不安全动作，且 99.4%（352/354）的运行有某个后续角色不安全；对每个读都施加状态过滤才把全部列降为零。
results.setting: Graphiti 共享存储，执行者/审查者/规划者三角色各按自己的问题检索，九场景 x 九模型 x 十次试验共 2,430 次运行，默认检索条件（无过滤）
results.quote: Given an executor that went unsafe, the reviewer chose the unsafe action on its own read in 341341 of 354354 runs (96.3%96.3\%), and some later role went unsafe in 352352 of 354354 (99.4%99.4\%).

denominator.n_total: 354 runs with a poisoned executor (shared store, default retrieval)
denominator.n_valid: 341/354 reviewer unsafe; 352/354 any later role unsafe
denominator.how_counted: reviewer unsafe on its own read given a poisoned executor (Section C.2)

results.claim: 在端到端工具动作测量中，置于工具边界的护栏（拒绝危险 shell 命令）在工具执行率上与无防御完全相同，确认外传仅少两例；起作用的是作用于读之前的控制（检索过滤器与本文 guard，§C.3 Table 16 中二者均 8/360 且无确认外传）——遏制边界在读而非工具层。
results.value: 17.2% (62/360) for the tool-layer guardrail, identical to no defense
results.setting: 四个工具场景（任意代码执行/破坏性 shell/密钥外传/绕过受认可 API）x 九模型 x 十次试验共 360 次运行，工具为诱饵、密钥为合成 token，四防御条件（无防御/检索过滤器/guard/工具层护栏）
results.quote: The tool-layer guardrail does not. Its tool execution rate is 62/360=17.2%62/360=17.2\%, identical to no defense, and it confirmed 77 exfiltrations against the 99 under no defense, a difference of two events on the same trials.

denominator.n_total: 360 runs (4 tool-facing scenarios x 9 models x 10 trials)
denominator.n_valid: 8/360 under filter and under guard; 62/360 under tool-layer guardrail and under no defense
denominator.how_counted: tool execution rate per defense condition (Section C.3)

limitations.statement: 跨系统配对检验统计功效有限：17 个不一致对下，只有 13-to-4 或更极端的分裂才显著，因此该比较只能支持两系统无粗略差异，不能证明它们等同。
limitations.quote: With 17 discordant pairs a two-sided exact test attains significance only at a 13-to-4 split or more extreme, so this comparison could not have detected a systematic advantage unless roughly three-quarters of the discordant cells fell the same way.

limitations.statement: 未报告合并比例的逐条件置信区间；作者论证格间离散远大于格内随机性，且格间离散只是对固定九场景九模型网格的描述而非泛化区间。
limitations.quote: We do not report per-condition confidence intervals on the pooled proportions.

limitations.statement: 有规则/无规则两组场景不是受控比较：两组在场景、动作集与干扰事实数上都不同，且研究从未对同一场景测量有无禁令的差别，只能支持较窄的结论（提示词禁令不能可靠阻止不安全动作）。
limitations.quote: The two groups are not a controlled comparison, since they differ in scenario, action set and distractor count, and the study never measures the same scenario with and without its prohibition.

limitations.statement: guard 的内容冲突启发式在部分间接插入条件下比不防御还差（cognee 53/810 vs 44/810；Graphiti 83/810 vs 81/810），因为冲突测试也会匹配并非撤销政策及其替代的矛盾对；在 Zep 上仅捕获 4/14。

title: MemSentry: A Framework for Detecting Persistent Memory Poisoning in Agentic AI

object.carrier: agent long-term/persistent memory entries (proposed persistent-memory writes derived from emails, webhooks, user-uploaded files, webpages, shared documents); MemSentry intercepts each write before it is committed to active memory

safety_property.statement: Committing a proposed persistent-memory write must not degrade the agentic system's security posture (e.g., suppress security alerts, facilitate privilege escalation, alter trust relationships, override security policies); external-unverified writes are unconditionally quarantined and non-negotiable authority/security policy rules hold regardless of the learned poisoning-risk score. The property structurally weakens for verified insiders with maximal trust (T=1): their dangerous writes are escalated to human Review rather than automatically quarantined.
safety_property.operationalized_as: A deterministic Accept/Review/Quarantine decision per proposed write, computed from source trust T, pluggable semantic risk, attack radius over a 20-asset dependency DAG, access risk, and a signed security-state delta; judged by per-class decision accuracy over 1,000 GPT-4-generated scenarios (100% external quarantine-class detection with all four semantic methods; best classifier 91.7% overall accuracy), an insider authorization sweep, and a held-out contrast set.

capabilities: External adversary: unauthenticated actor injecting content through external channels (emails, webhooks, third-party APIs); can craft arbitrary message content; cannot authenticate as an internal user
Compromised insider (secondary attacker class): authenticated internal user passing identity verification with authorized access to some components, submitting adversarial content that exploits trust
Attacks act through stored memory content only, without modifying model weights or system prompts
assumptions: Source trust T can be computed from origin (external vs. internal), identity verification status, and channel integrity
The protected system can be modeled as a static component-dependency DAG with criticality scores plus an access-control matrix
A pluggable classifier can map an operation to a semantic category and risk score
MemSentry implementation was frozen prior to GPT-4 dataset generation to reduce the risk of overfitting to the evaluation scenarios
not_covered: Coordinated multi-step campaigns (evaluation considers individual memory operations only)
Retrieval-time or post-commit defense (MemSentry is pre-commit; poisoned entries already in persistent memory are out of scope)
Automatic quarantine of verified insiders (T=1 zeroes projected degradation, so insider operations are routed to Review instead)
Dynamic changes in security posture or dependency structure during evaluation (treated as static)

intervention.name: MemSentry
intervention.description: A formal, configuration-driven 9-step pre-admission pipeline that intercepts proposed persistent-memory writes: (1) source trust from provenance/identity/channel; (2) pluggable semantic classification (Regex, TF-IDF+SVM, SBERT+LR, or SetFit) into risk-scored categories; (3) attack radius over a component-dependency DAG; (4) access risk against an access-control matrix; (5-7) current and projected security posture with a signed security-state delta scaled by a persistence factor; (8) a weighted risk score; (9) deterministic rule-based Accept/Review/Quarantine decisions, including a mandatory policy-constraint rule that quarantines any external-unverified source regardless of content. Decisions emit template-based (non-LLM) audit explanations; a counterfactual impact evaluation compares executions with and without the candidate memory to quantify observed blast radius.

title: SoK: Rethinking Jailbreaking in the Era of Agentic AI: Attacks, Defenses, and Practical Considerations

object.carrier: SoK 系统化的对象是 agentic 执行管线各组件中可被对抗性内容持久化的状态：持久记忆（short-term/long-term/RAG，如 MINJA 注入后被存储并在后续交互中检索）、规划与推理轨迹（TRACE/CoT 劫持）、工具调用与外部动作（AgentHarm/STAC）、代理间通信消息（Agent Smith/ARCJ 传染式越狱），以及跨轮积累的攻击策略（AutoDAN-Turbo 的策略发现与检索）

safety_property.statement: 核心安全属性是策略合规（safety-policy bypass）：论文将越狱定义为绕过显式模型级或代理级安全策略以诱导被禁止的生成、推理、存储、工具使用或执行；同时覆盖其衍生的机密性（data exfiltration）与完整性/权限（unauthorized action、goal hijacking）目标。中心主张：响应级安全不等于代理级安全——最终响应安全不保证规划、记忆、工具交互安全；评估须分离 native harmful-prompt safety、adversarial jailbreak robustness 与 agent-level security 三个层次，并联合考虑 over-refusal、utility、latency 与计算成本
safety_property.operationalized_as: 安全–效用–效率框架（Fig.4）：ASR=FN/(TP+FN)、DSR、ORR=FP/(TN+FP)（Eq.1-2，GPT-5-mini 逐响应判定）、aggregate utility=(AR+RQ+Helpfulness)/3（Eq.4）、DeepEval Bias、推理时间/端到端延迟/推理 token/总 token；agent 级组件指标：unsafe planning (UP)、unsafe memory (UM)、poison retrieval (PR)、unsafe search input (USI)、unsafe task-tool interactions (UTI)（AgentHarm-chat，Tables 9-11）；综合分为模型内 min-max 归一化加权分（仅模型内可比）

capabilities: 主要考虑黑盒对手：可控制用户输入与外部供给内容（检索内容、记忆、工具输出、代理间消息），但不能修改可信系统提示词、模型参数或基础设施
也考虑更强白盒对手：可访问模型内部信息（参数/梯度/logits/隐表示）或防御信息
攻击目标覆盖最终响应越狱与组件级不安全行为（规划、记忆写入、工具调用、代理间传播）
assumptions: prompt injection 仅在绕过显式安全策略时计为 jailbreak；仅重定向已授权任务而不绕过策略者不在范围内
实验在固定代理架构的统一 LangGraph 评估框架内进行，tool model 固定为 Qwen3.5-4B，final models 为 Qwen3.5-4B 与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，评审为 GPT-5-mini（Table 8 另加人工核验）
研究范围刻意分离系统化广度与实验深度：分类法覆盖规划/工具/记忆/多代理面，受控实验只针对代表性模型层推理时防御
not_covered: 能修改系统提示词、模型参数或基础设施的内部攻击者（作为假设排除）
不以防绕过安全策略为目标的通用可靠性控制（明确排除在防御分类之外）
训练时投毒类攻击仅在分类法中列出（如 Universal Jailbreak Backdoor），未进入受控实验
闭源前沿大模型：受控实验仅用两个开源小模型，结论限定于该设置

intervention.name: Agentic jailbreak 攻防分类法 + security–utility–efficiency 评估框架（Fig.2/Fig.3/Fig.4）
intervention.description: 两层贡献：(1) 攻击分类法（Fig.2）按黑盒（user-agent、planning&reasoning、agent-tool、agent-memory、agent-agent 五个交互面）与白盒（梯度/搜索/表示感知优化）组织 116 种攻击；防御分类法（Fig.3）按被保护的架构层组织 63 种防御：model&reasoning（安全训练/输入过滤/内部状态与解码控制/输出分类校验修订）、context&state（CaMeL、A-MemGuard、SMSR）、planning&orchestration（ShieldAgent、AgentSpec）、tools&execution（Progent、AttriGuard）、inter-agent communication（AutoDefense、TrinityGuard）。(2) 在统一 LangGraph 代理框架内对 16 个代表性推理时防御做受控对比，主张从响应中心防御转向跨层、执行感知安全（保护 agent 状态、组件转换与外部动作）

results.claim: 文献筛选规模：2022-2026 多源检索（最后更新 2026 年 8 月）筛出 271 篇攻击相关与 88 篇防御相关候选研究/方法
results.setting: SoK 自身的文献检索（Google Scholar/ACM DL/IEEE Xplore/ACL Anthology/arXiv/OpenReview + 前后向引文追踪）
results.quote: This search identified 271 attack-related and 88 defense-related candidate studies or methods for screening.

results.claim: 最终分类法覆盖 116 种不同 jailbreak 攻击与 63 种不同防御，横跨传统模型层技术与新兴 agentic 攻击面——这是该 SoK 的核心系统化产出
results.setting: 对保留文献按对抗访问、攻击面、目标组件、持久性、交互结构、优化机制、信任边界、防御阶段编码后得到
results.quote: The resulting taxonomy contains 116 distinct jailbreak attacks and 63 distinct defenses, spanning traditional model-level techniques and emerging agentic attack surfaces.

results.claim: 受控实验规模：统一 LangGraph 代理框架内基准测试 16 个代表性 jailbreak 防御，另设未防御 Vanilla 基线

limitations.statement: 作者自陈范围限制：系统化广度与实验深度分离——分类法覆盖规划/工具/记忆/多代理攻击与防御面，但受控实验仅针对代表性模型层推理时防御；目标不是声称这些防御提供完整代理级保护
limitations.quote: Our scope separates systematization breadth from empirical depth. The taxonomy covers jailbreak-relevant attack and defense surfaces across planning, tools, memory, and multi-agent interaction, whereas the controlled experiments

limitations.statement: 综合分只在同一模型内可比：min-max 归一化是模型特定的，跨模型的分数不可直接比较（也意味着表 2-7 与表 5-7 的分值不能跨模型排名）

limitations.quote: Component safeguards are not yet end-to-end jailbreak defenses.

limitations.statement: 当前评测（含本文）多考虑单次交互内的攻击，而部署中的代理在长轨迹上运行并随时间积累状态——自适应与持久对手仍然缺乏研究
limitations.quote: Many evaluations consider attacks within a single interaction, whereas deployed agents operate over extended trajectories and accumulate state over time.

title: PolicyMem: Geometric Policy Memory for LLM Governance

object.carrier: 几何策略记忆 M_T={(t_p, U_p)}：每条自然语言策略经共享 subspace compiler 编译为 governance 空间中的低秩正交子空间基 U_p（r_s=8, d_g=256 的 memory slot），与策略文本地址成对持久化；槽位为当前策略配置物化、更新间缓存、部署期可固定不变，配置变更时重跑同一写操作刷新；co-trained 记忆仅 0.6 MB（Table 5）

safety_property.statement: 保护 LLM 响应对已配置自然语言策略集的合规性（unsafe behavior 治理）：assessor 基于逐策略投影能量证据给出 safe/unsafe 交付判定，仅 safe 判定允许交付；违规响应经 TopK 归因映射回自然语言策略反馈驱动重写，重写由同一 assessor+记忆复检，至多 B 轮仍违规则回退固定拒绝。边界条件：论文限定英文 query-response 与 detect-rewrite-verify 工作流（Limitations）；覆盖分数可分性不意味着单一校准阈值可跨 taxonomy 统一迁移（§C.1）。
safety_property.operationalized_as: 五基准（BT/WGM/Aeg/Bin/SRL）上的 Safe-F1/Unsafe-F1（检测）、mAP（策略归因）、LLM-judge Safety/Information/Helpfulness + Overall good-rewrite rate（重写，judge=OpenAI o3）、max-energy coverage AUROC（含 leave-one-taxonomy-out 泛化）

capabilities: 论文未建模具体对手；评估对象为五个安全治理基准中的不安全 query-response（WildGuardMix 含 vanilla 与 adversarial prompts），单标签/多标签不安全响应均覆盖
assumptions: 治理策略可以自然语言枚举配置（各基准 14/13/20/11/19 条 policy slots，co-trained 并集 77 条）
assessor/rewriter 与策略记忆自身可信（未考虑针对治理器的攻击）
英文 query-response 文本模态；检测与验证共享同一配置记忆
not_covered: 针对 PolicyMem 治理器自身的对抗/逃避攻击
策略记忆投毒或篡改
多语言与多模态治理（Limitations 明示为 future work）
真实世界分布漂移下的鲁棒性（Limitations 明示为 future work）
跨用户/隐私维度

intervention.name: PolicyMem（closed-loop detect-rewrite-verify governor）
intervention.description: 将策略执行外置为可复用的操作化记忆架构：memory writer 把自然语言策略编译为低秩子空间槽位；query-response 对经共享适配编码器读出逐策略投影能量 e∈[0,1]^N_T，verdict 模块只接收证据概要的置换不变 7 维摘要（不接收 query-response 原文与策略名/描述），使几何记忆读取成为强制决策接口而非事后解释；TopK 高能槽位映射回策略文本反馈条件化 rewriter 重写，重写经同一 assessor+配置记忆复检，safe 即交付、超预算 B 轮则固定拒绝。
